name: sol-advisor
description: Bootstraps a fresh Sol / Max orchestrator that autonomously selects routes, models, and reasoning effort.

interface.shortDescription: Let a fresh Sol / Max orchestrator choose the route, model, and effort.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor can be invoked from any primary model. It automatically dispatches the task to a fresh GPT-6 Sol / Max orchestrator without asking the user to confirm a model, effort, or lane. The orchestrator selects solo, delegate, audit, or full delivery and chooses each auxiliary model and reasoning effort from the currently available native agents. Luna is preferred for bounded routine work, Terra for ordinary complex implementation, Sol for hard synthesis and review, and Astra only for a bounded big-think consult whose ambiguity, stakes, and downstream consequences justify the usage.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to complete and verify this task.
Let Sol Advisor choose the route, auxiliary model, and reasoning effort automatically.
